It takes twenty minutes to get to the dance studio by bike. The dance studio is one of the best places in the city. Anna drinks tea after doing sports. Best of all, they go fishing at the lake at dawn.
Anna thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Anna's favorite animal is the rabbit. Sam's birthday is in May. The coach checked our names on her clipboard.
Last Thursday, Anna and Sam went to the dance studio. Anna hopes to visit Rome one day. Both of them like rice and tea. For example, follow me into the garden.
The weather was cloudy that day. Anna and Sam had great fun there. Sam is interested in dancing.
